name: resume-portfolio-workflow
description: A user-confirmed workflow that verifies resume content, compares multiple design directions, selects one media-direction winner, and builds expressive React + Vite portfolios with optional media search.

interface.shortDescription: Verified resume content to expressive portfolio site
interface.longDescription: Use resume-portfolio-workflow to route full and fast changes, resume-content-intelligence to verify and approve content, and build-resume-portfolio-site to compare layouts, implement one media-direction winner, audit the result, and add source-agnostic production-hardened motion.
defaultPrompt: Turn my resume into a verified portfolio website
Build a React portfolio from approved content and implement one media-direction winner
Audit and improve my portfolio with source-agnostic production-hardened motion
